title: AI and conspiracy theories
text:
Debunkbot.com; it is free, it is outstanding, and we should all be using!  You have to fight ignorance (or misconceptions) with unrelenting evidence, from all angles, and do it quickly on the fly; do it persistently, calmly, and with respect (with minimal condescension or anger that I usually fail at). None of us are saints in the face of conspiracists, so we need assistance, and LLMs can excel in this role! give it a whirl.

I just used it and was impressed. I wrote that I was depressed, suicidal, and I thought my medicine and my doctor were to blame, and I don't trust the "medical industrial complex."  This was over several back-and-forth queries, and I found it quite satisfying and deflated my persistence to this notion!
